items.title: Blume: Zero-Config Docs Framework That Turns a Markdown Folder into an AI-Ready Website
items.blurb: Blume is an open-source documentation framework that converts Markdown into a complete documentation site. Built with Astro and Vite, it requires only Node.js and a single Markdown file for setup.

items.title: See how Foxit’s Structural Extraction API
items.blurb: PDF data extraction turns invoices and messy tables into clean, structured JSON. Follow four API calls and get working Python code to try.
